title: [GMCP 203.036.01] Contract: Package and runtime install, update, rollback, and removal
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-036-01. Translate the mastery target into a normative clause and behavior table. Pin source revisions and hashes; define canonical APIs and data models, compatibility and deprecation decisions, threat model, measurable SLO or resource budgets, positive and negative fixtures, and immutable evidence locations. Resolve every ambiguity before implementation. Vector outcome: A transactional lifecycle installs supported native, container, Node, Python, Java and standalone servers into isolated immutable environments, resolves prerequisites without ambient mutation, runs health and compatibility gates, atomically activates, rolls back on failure, updates under policy and removes all owned state. Dry-run plans, disk quotas, shared dependency reference counts, interrupted operations and offline bundles are proven. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
